name: What are some popular upgrades or features to consider during a pool renovation?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular upgrades or features to consider during a pool renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular upgrades for a pool renovation often focus on aesthetics, functionality, and energy efficiency. Consider modernizing finishes with pebble or quartz plaster, upgrading to designer tiles, or installing natural stone coping and decking. For functionality, adding a spa, custom water features like sheer descents or waterfalls, or sun shelves are common. Energy-efficient pumps, LED lighting, automated control systems, and salt chlorine generators are also popular for reducing maintenance and operational costs while enhancing the swimming experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular upgrades include modern finishes, designer tiles, natural stone, spas, water features, sun shelves, energy-efficient equipment, and smart controls.
